chapter: Army band, Lena Horne, Billie Holiday and the 1950s
title: Bob Crosby and the Bobcats; close of the session
summary: Horace recalls working with Bob Crosby, who sought him out at the Riviera; they will cover it next time. End of proceedings.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Oh yes. We've got to talk about Bob Crosby and his Bobcats. I made some things with them too.
Okay. Great. Well, we'll get into those next time around.

Eddie Miller. They were great guys. I met Bob Crosby when I was with Billy Williams at the Riviera. He came right up to me while I was rehearsing. He didn't know who Billy was. He walked right past Billy and says, 'Where's Horace Henderson?' and so and so? He knew me. He came over. Oh boy.
So you did some things for him?
Great. Okay, we'll get 'em next time around then.
Well, it sure has been a pleasure.
